items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: But this was -- as I say this was a very great band, and we travelled by train. And this is why a lot -- I would give Paul my guitar, and Paul would play some very pretty things on guitar.

ctx.x: Violin. Until it was time for Nat to go on, and he would go on and play with us. And Duke, again never acknowledged his absence. It was just as if he'd been there all along. You know, he'd smile through it all. It never touched him. But this was -- as I say this was a very great band, and we travelled by train. And this is why a lot -- I would give Paul my guitar, and Paul would play some very pretty things on guitar. But I met Paul years ago when I was with Roy Eldridge in Taunton, I believe, Mass. He was up…
So I was aware of the fact, but few people knew that he played guitar.
